elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies to “each Party” and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The cap uses all amounts paid or payable during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim, rather than fees during the twelve months preceding the claim.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 provides that “neither Party” is liable for indirect, consequential, and the other listed damages.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party’s breach of confidentiality obligations is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Breaches of data-protection or security obligations are Excluded Claims and therefore uncapped.
A Party’s indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims and therefore outside the cap.
Gross negligence is expressly included within Excluded Claims.
Wilful misconduct is expressly included within Excluded Claims.
Fraud is expressly included within Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Infringement or misappropriation of the other Party’s intellectual property is an Excluded Claim.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 excludes only undisputed Fees for conforming Services, not all Customer payment obligations.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies the cap to “each Party” and expressly confirms mutuality.

elements.element: The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
elements.evidence: The cap is calculated using all amounts paid or payable by Customer under the Agreement and Order Forms during a twelve-month lookback, subject to a USD 1,000,000 floor.
Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims and therefore outside the cap.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Breach of confidentiality obligations is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the cap.
Gross negligence is expressly included within Excluded Claims.
Wilful misconduct is expressly included within Excluded Claims.
